messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on a Monday when the actual date falls on a weekend), giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.

| Date(s) | Holiday | Province(s) affected | Notes |
|---------|---------|----------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 (Thu)** | New Year’s Day | All | Observed on Monday Jan 2 (so Jan 1‑2 is a 2‑day weekend). |
| **Feb 20 (Mon)** | Family Day | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, PEI, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador | 3‑day weekend: Feb 18‑20. |
| **Mar 6 (Mon)** | BC Day of Celebration | British Columbia | 3‑day weekend: Mar 4‑6. |
| **Apr 7 (Fri)** | Good Friday | All | 3‑day weekend: Apr 7‑9. |
| **May 22 (Mon)** | Victoria Day | All | 3‑day weekend: May 20‑22. |
| **Jul 1 (Sat)** | Canada Day | All | Observed on Monday Jul 3 → 3‑day weekend: Jul 1‑3. |
| **Sep 4 (Mon)** | Labour Day | All | 3‑day weekend: Sep 2‑4. |
| **Oct 9 (Mon)** | Thanksgiving | All | 3‑day weekend: Oct 7‑9. |
| **Nov 11 (Fri)** | Remembrance Day | All | 3‑day weekend: Nov 11‑13. |
| **Dec 23 (Sat)** | Christmas Day | All | 3‑day weekend: Dec 23‑25. |
| **Dec 26 (Tue)** | Boxing Day | All | Not a long weekend (falls on a Tuesday). |

### Quick‑look calendar view

```
Jan 2023
 1 Thu – New Year’s Day (observed Mon 2)
Feb 2023
20 Mon – Family Day (Ontario, etc.)
Mar 2023
 6 Mon – BC Day of Celebration
Apr 2023
 7 Fri – Good Friday
May 2023
22 Mon – Victoria Day
Jul 2023
 1 Sat – Canada Day (observed Mon 3)
Sep 2023
 4 Mon – Labour Day
Oct 2023
 9 Mon – Thanksgiving
Nov 2023
11 Fri – Remembrance Day
Dec 2023
23 Sat – Christmas Day (observed Mon 25)
```

> **Tip for planning:**  
> • If you’re in a province that observes Family Day (e.g., Ontario, Alberta, etc.), you’ll get the Feb 20 long weekend.  
> • BC residents should note the March 6 BC Day of Celebration.  
> • For the rest of Canada, the above dates apply.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like it in a different format (CSV, JSON, etc.).
